veranderings.rede: A Grade 4 reader easily takes contrastive 'weer' as 'again', suggesting the tankers carry oil a second time; the sentence reads clearly without it.

vlae.teks: 'n Vragskip wat baie groot houers vol goedere oor die see dra.
vlae.rede: 'baie groot houers' reads most naturally as 'very big containers', while the study text says 'duisende groot houers' (many big containers); which meaning is intended cannot be settled without guessing, so it is flagged, not changed.
